definitions.explanation: A formal gathering held to celebrate an achievement, milestone, or special occasion such as a promotion, anniversary, or award.

examples.japanese: {祝賀会|しゅくがかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}する→出席する：01830_shussekisuru⟧。
⟦{優勝|ゆうしょう}→優勝：03647_yuushou⟧{祝賀会|しゅくがかい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: A victory celebration was held at a hotel.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦{創立|そうりつ}→創立：15353_souritsu⟧50⟦{周年|しゅうねん}→周年：09520_shuunen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{祝賀会|しゅくがかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関係者|かんけいしゃ}→関係者：16441_kankeisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{招|まね}かれた→招く：02425_maneku⟧。
examples.english: Many associates were invited to the company's 50th anniversary celebration.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{祝賀|しゅくが}→祝賀：14770_shukuga⟧ (celebration, congratulation) + ⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧ (gathering, party). Refers to formal celebratory events, often with speeches and toasts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {祝賀会|しゅくがかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧ (to hold a celebration)
- {祝賀会|しゅくがかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}する→出席する：01830_shussekisuru⟧ (to attend a celebration)
- ⟦{優勝|ゆうしょう}→優勝：03647_yuushou⟧{祝賀会|しゅくがかい} (victory celebration)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{祝賀|しゅくが}→祝賀：14770_shukuga⟧: celebration — the act of celebrating, without implying a gathering
- ⟦{歓迎会|かんげいかい}→歓迎会：15791_kangeikai⟧: welcome party — a party to welcome someone
- ⟦{祝|いわ}い→祝い：01838_iwai⟧: celebration — a more casual, everyday term
